ddl.name: box_office_claims_one_live_per_seat
ddl.where: seat_id IS NOT NULL AND state IN ('held', 'confirmed')

ddl.name: core_jobs_dedupe
ddl.where: dedupe_key IS NOT NULL AND state IN ('queued', 'running')

ddl.name: membership_memberships_renewed_once
ddl.where: state IN ('pending', 'active') AND renews_id IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: payments_attempts_reader_busy
ddl.where: reader_id IS NOT NULL AND state IN ('started', 'pending')

ddl.name: bar_price_lists_standard
ddl.value: "system_key" IS NULL OR ("percent_off" IS NULL AND "active" = 1)

ddl.name: box_office_claims_released
ddl.value: ("state" = 'released') = ("released_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("state" = 'released') = ("release_reason" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: box_office_order_lines_ticket
ddl.value: "kind" <> 'ticket' OR ("performance_id" IS NOT NULL AND "band_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket_type_id" IS NOT NULL AND "claim_id" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: box_office_orders_account_needed
ddl.value: "account_id" IS NOT NULL OR "state" IN ('basket', 'expired') OR ("channel" = 'desk' AND "access_note" IS NULL AND "state" <> 'reserved')

ddl.name: box_office_scans_reason
ddl.value: "result" NOT IN ('reversed', 'admitted_by_override') OR "reason_term_id" IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: box_office_tickets_requirement
ddl.value: "requirement_ref" IS NULL OR "requirement_account_id" IS NOT NULL OR "requirement_evidence_id" IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: core_accounts_not_merged_into_itself
ddl.value: merged_into_id IS NULL OR merged_into_id <> id

ddl.name: core_accounts_name_length
ddl.value: name IS NULL OR length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 120

ddl.name: core_accounts_pronouns_length
ddl.value: pronouns IS NULL OR length(pronouns) BETWEEN 1 AND 40

ddl.name: core_closures_scope
ddl.value: "space_id" IS NULL OR "venue_id" IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: core_emergency_contacts_relationship
ddl.value: "relationship" IS NULL OR length("relationship") BETWEEN 1 AND 40

ddl.name: core_grants_scope
ddl.value:
(scope = 'site' AND scope_module IS NULL AND scope_type IS NULL AND scope_id IS NULL)
      OR (scope = 'module' AND scope_module IS NOT NULL AND scope_type IS NULL AND scope_id IS NULL)
      OR (scope = 'record' AND scope_module IS NOT NULL AND scope_type IS NOT NULL AND scope_id IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: core_notifications_recipient
ddl.value: ("account_id" IS NULL) <> ("address" IS NULL) OR "payload" IS NULL

ddl.name: core_performances_label
ddl.value: "label" IS NULL OR length("label") BETWEEN 1 AND 40

ddl.name: core_performances_cancel
ddl.value: ("state" = 'cancelled') = ("cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cancel_reason_term_id" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: front_of_house_incident_people_who
ddl.value: "account_id" IS NOT NULL OR "name" IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: front_of_house_incidents_closed
ddl.value: "state" <> 'closed' OR ("closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "closing_note" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: front_of_house_night_reports_signed
ddl.value: "state" = 'draft' OR ("snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "signed_off_at" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: front_of_house_shifts_title
ddl.value: ("performance_id" IS NOT NULL OR "title" IS NOT NULL) AND ("title" IS NULL OR length("title") <= 80)

ddl.name: membership_fees_charges_paid
ddl.value: "state" <> 'paid' OR ("intent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "paid_at" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: membership_memberships_active
ddl.value: "state" <> 'active' OR ("starts_on" IS NOT NULL AND "activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("needs_verification" = 0 OR "verified_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("needs_approval" = 0 OR "approved_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("needs_payment" = 0 OR "paid_at" IS NOT NULL))

ddl.name: membership_memberships_dates
ddl.value: "ends_on" IS NULL OR "starts_on" IS NULL OR "ends_on" >= "starts_on"

ddl.name: membership_schemes_fixed_end
ddl.value: ("length_rule" = 'fixed') = ("fixed_end_month" IS NOT NULL AND "fixed_end_day" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: membership_schemes_fixed_end_valid
ddl.value: "fixed_end_month" IS NULL OR ("fixed_end_month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND "fixed_end_day" BETWEEN 1 AND (CASE WHEN "fixed_end_month" = 2 THEN 28 WHEN "fixed_end_month" IN (4, 6, 9, 11) THEN 30 ELSE 31 END))

ddl.name: payments_refunds_two_people
ddl.value: "approved_by" IS NULL OR "requested_by" IS NULL OR "approved_by" <> "requested_by" OR "amount_minor" <= "self_approve_limit_minor"
